_comment: RepoYeti's tray-host config, read by misc/lunarwerx-tray.exe (source vendored beside it in
misc/tray-host-native/). This file is the whole per-app surface; the host binary is generic and
shared, exactly as RepoYeti-Tray.ps1's $TrayConfig hashtable was.
Paths are relative to THIS file unless absolute. %VAR% expands an environment variable,
%VAR|fallback% supplies a default, and a leading ~ is the user profile.
_compiled: Release layout (the -with-tray zip): a compiled repoyeti.exe sits at the app root, so run THAT
instead of bun + src/, and don't require bun on PATH at all. A source checkout has no exe at
the root, so this key simply doesn't resolve there and the bun path above stays in force.
Resolving it also disables firstRun, whose three steps bootstrap a checkout and would each
fire in a bundle that ships everything already built.
_shutdown: No token: RepoYeti uses the force-kill flavour, so shutdownTokenEnvVar stays unset.
_wait: A cold start scans the whole root and can take up to a minute, well above the 12-15s family default.
_hint: Layout-neutral on purpose: one static config serves both a source checkout and a release bundle, and the bundle has no src/ to point a bun command at.
notServingHint:
RepoYeti started but isn't serving.

The most likely cause is that no scan root is configured. Open a terminal in this folder and add one:

    repoyeti.exe add-root <path-to-your-git-projects>

(from a source checkout: bun run src\index.ts add-root <path>)

then click RepoYeti again. (Other causes: a failed web build, or no free port.)
